text:
First thing we get is strong musty smell when we opened the door to the room.

Stayed there for the location, very near taipei railway station. Clear instructions from station to the hotel.

Dangerous bathing area within narrow bathtub that trips my boy.

Welcome tea in terms of voucher to exchange drinks with their cafe which tastes great.

Nice bed and clean bed compared to the rest of the room
Very dangerous for old people bathing in bathtub. No privacy changing.

Wonderful stay with very neat environment 
I went during xmas and the hotel was well decorated with a big xmas tree and Santa Clause to take photos with
Restaurants in hotel are also fantastic except they are quite fully booked
In general, we would love to return to the hotel next time
Overall experience is great with friendly staff.  Location a bit far, but they have provide the shuttle service to pick up and drop off. If have any chance, I will come back again.

Thoroughly love this hotel! Second home in Taipei! Located in the heart of Xinyi  shopping district with plenty of food choices, movie theatre, shopping and pubs around the hotel! Friendly staffs and cleanliness is tip top. Definitely will be my first choice of hotel to stay in Taipei Taiwan!

All the staff members were very friendly. I was especially pleased with the staff in the breakfast area who welcomed us warmly. They interacted with us using a mix of basic Japanese and English, gestures, and smiles, making for a wonderful breakfast experience. Over the three days we enjoyed breakfast, the menu changed slightly each day, catering to my father who wanted local dishes, my mother who wanted tropical fruits, and my eldest son who doesn’t quite like local food and opted for regular breakfast items like white rice, miso soup, bacon, potatoes, and eggs. On the other hand, my younger son happily tried many dishes and seemed to really enjoy desserts such as regular Yakult about the size of Japan's Yakult 1000, pudding that couldn't be flipped like the Pucchin Pudding, and yogurt that overflowed when the lid was opened.

I was moved to find that our room had already been cleaned when we returned from breakfast. Every day, bottled water was provided based on the number of guests, so it was convenient to put it in the fridge before going out, allowing us to enjoy cold water when we came back from sightseeing.

I particularly liked that the bathroom had a clear partition instead of a shower curtain. The wet floor can be quite stressful, so I was able to use the sink and toilet comfortably. I did wonder why the toilet paper was positioned as it was, but it's something we can laugh about, so it wasn't a problem.

When I made the hotel reservation, the room amenities included a bathrobe, but it was not available in reality. I’m not sure if it was a mistake from the booking site, but if someone absolutely needs one, it might be good to check beforehand.

There is a weighing scale in the room, which was helpful for measuring our luggage.

The MRT entrance is very close to the hotel, making it extremely convenient.

If I have the opportunity to travel to Taiwan again, I would definitely want to stay at this hotel again. It was a fun trip! Thank you very much to everyone at Cosmos Hotel!

This hotel is amazing! 
The staff was super nice, the breakfast was delicious, and the swimming pool, sauna, and hot baths were just incredible – wow!
The rooms were huge, spotless, and we really appreciated the complimentary snacks and sodas. There’s even a water dispenser in the hall. It was clearly the best hotel we stayed at in Taiwan!

We added another night with another booking, and could keep the same room ! This was really helpful ! The staff made everything possible to make the stay amazing. 

A small remark: it would be great if the lifeguard at the swimming pool could wear indoor shoes since guests walk barefoot, and if the staff could kindly remind people to take off their shoes before entering the bath/swimming pool area.
Also, it would be amazing if the swimming pool could stay open at least until 10:00 PM.

Thank you again, Miramar Garden Hotel Team, for this wonderful stay – you made it truly unforgettable for our group!
After countless times expressing my fondness for this hotel, they finally had the opportunity to join me this November. Without a doubt, the girls enjoyed the place as much as I do. Cheers!

I used it for the first time in Taiwan.
The room was clean and spacious with a big bed, which was great!
The night view from the balcony was especially beautiful.
I went shopping at the night market and enjoyed B-class gourmet food, and the hotel restaurant was a high-class restaurant, which made me feel a little rich.
Also, the convenience store Family Mart is located in the annex!
I happened to stay in the annex, so it was convenient (^ ^)

I booked Cosmos for a few times. But this time, I make a mistake booking the superior room. XD
If you take your kids with you, do not book superior double, coz it's quite small. 
My kid still enjoyed and have a good sleep.
If you want a better experience, try to book a bigger room.
Good facility, nice breakfast and friendly staff

The hotel location is very well on one of the most convenient spot in Taipei! Has all the mode of transport link to this point! The hotel on the other hand is old and maintain its traditional look. Overall, it’s a pleasant stay!

Nice, clean and convenient location. Only slight drawback this stay was they refused to allow me to extend the check out to 12 noon from their usual 11.00 am. After many attempts at asking, they finally agreed to extend my check out to 11.30 am
Otherwise I had a pleasant stay

Had a pleasant stay at Brother Hotel Taipei. The location is really strategic which right next to the train station, which made getting around the city super convenient. There are also plenty of convenience stores and local food stalls nearby. The hotel staff were all very polite and helpful throughout my stay. Overall, it’s a great place to stay if you're looking for comfort and convenience in Taipei.

I stayed at Marriott during my birthday trip and they are lovely enough to send me a cheese cake on my actual day. A big plus point! Not only that the staff are also very friendly and helpful. I truly enjoyed my stay.

We enjoyed this hotel because the rooms are spacious, the toiletries smell so good, the location is just next M3 exit of Taipei Main Station. It is a few steps away from the Klook's group tour meet-up at E3. They have a nice cafe and the restaturant nearby serves yummy beef noodles and pork buns

This was our place when we stayed for five nights in Ximending. About 10 mins. walk to everything! We had a pleasant stay. The room we got has another room for the two beds so it was amazing! A big room for both of us.  The front desk staff was also very helpful in all of our concerns.

It's my first time to travel alone and I really enjoyed staying at this place. It was located near main station (not too close), and easy to access grocery market and bus stops. Also they keep the rooms and facilities clean, and staff were most likely nice. It would've been great if I brought company with, so I could  saved some money.  Quite expensive for solo traveller but great for couples and family.
Friendly staff and good communication

Friendly staff with good attitude
The place is clean and the room is spacious
Enjoyed my stay here and i love the location, amazing!

Centrally located, next to Taipei Main Station, with MRT intersection, High Speed Rail (including airport link), buses and loads of tourist bus meets, this hotel is compact but clean, well priced and friendly staff. With a welcome drink card, a happy hour drink card and decent breakfast spread, it makes up for the compact rooms and lack of free water refilling station (though you do get a fresh bottle of water each day). I would definitely stay here again if in Taiwan, as the coffee downstairs is good, and there is a both a Family Mart and 7 Eleven either side, as well as a hole in the wall eatery that does pretty good cooked snacks.

Really had a good stay. Not close to a train station but many options for buses with many bus stops around. Nice that it has onsen facilities. Since Uber isn’t very pricey in Taipei, I didn’t mind the location and enjoyed my stay here. If the rates are good, will definitely stay here again.

It's a good old traditional hotel.  Nice friendly staff, generous with the amenities like water, coffee, tea etc...

Breakfast was a good ********* food like congee, pork buns sometimes, noodles, with some ham and sausages.

Fruits were the same for 7 days: good watermelon 🍉,  guava, and pale oranges that could be better.  Salad and bread section with butter, jams and sometimes peanut butter. Overall an okay filling Breakfast 👌.

Nice view of the river during breakfast at the top 12th floor.

Wheelchair ♿️ accessible.

Willing to go back but will try another hotel next time.

Stayed for 6 days. Location is great! Enjoyed the breakfast but the food is not warm and ran out quickly. Hope the hotel can improve the quality of food at breakfast and refilled the food . Overall, clean hotel.

It's a wonderful stay for business in a new neighborhood. There was nearby construction when I stayed there, but rooms are good at soundproofing.
Rooms are spacious with nice view. Staffs are nice that they offered me fresh fruits daily and even chocolate for good sleep at night.
Many options for food as the founder is initially in culinary industry before running this hotel: Taiwanese, Japanese, Italian,.. under your fingertips..
The room is clean and spacious. The facility is newly renovated. Friendly staff and very good breakfast.
Nice location. Good service. Large rooms. Overall a pleasant stay
Friendly staff and comfortable room

The hotel is conveniently located next to the MRT, making it easy to get around. The amenities include a gym, swimming pool, and Japanese bath, which enhance the overall experience. The staff are friendly and helpful, contributing to a pleasant stay. Our room had a comfortable king-size bed, and despite facing a busy street, it was quiet at night thanks to the soundproof windows.
Enjoyed the cafe and small shop selling souvenirs right outside the hotel. Near Taipei station and so everything is convenient.  Room is clean and the staff service is awesome.
Hotel was located next to the Taipei Main station. Good location and Friendly staff .
Reopen ex 6 stars hotel, still keep the vibe and super friendly staff, big bed and super clean

I stayed for one night with my family. The hotel has modern facilities, and the swimming pool was fantastic—warm water made swimming enjoyable even in cold weather. However, the service could be improved, as it took about an hour to get a response to a request during weekends or holidays. Overall, a pleasant stay with minor room for improvement.
Hotel rooms are very clean and kids enjoyed staying in there. There’s an onsen bathtub in the room so perfect for kids!
easy access and friendly staff

A bit far from the central area. 
But hotel is nice to just chill 
Friendly staff

The location of this hotel is around 10 to 15mins walk to Ximending area and  Ximen MRT station.  
The staffs are very accommodating and very helpful. Thank you.:)
My family enjoyed the snack bar as they were able to try different snacks in Taipei. 
The buffet breakfast spread is quite nice too, would be best if there will be scrambled egg station.hehe
Overall, if I will be back in Taipei, I would definitely book this hotel again. 
Thank you  to all the Staffs especially the ones stationed at the luggage area/taxi booking assistance.

The in-room onsen was fantastic! Plus the nice views, friendly staff, and highly accessible location. The only minor problem was the breakfast, tried the Taiwanese and Western style but both turned out to be below expectations. Maybe the taiwan restaurants have pampered us too much ;)

It is just next to the Taipei MRT station exit M3. 
Very helpful and friendly staff.
Super nice room and hotel, grand and clean, room attached with bathtub, friendly staff and easy to arrive the hotel

1. The air conditioner in the room is noisy. 2. The room is full of a strong smell of ozone. 3. Treat guests differently. We sat together in the lobby drinking beer, but enjoyed different treatment. We were given snacks by other guests. We were ignored. 4. There is nothing around the hotel, which is inconvenient.
The room is clean and quiet. We enjoyed our stay
Friendly staff, good location and spacious room, would have been perfect if there is a swimming pool or rooftop garden and bar for night view.
Very good location, friendly staff

I love the free activities provided by the hotel. 

I enjoyed the night walk tour organized by the hotel and the yoga classes. Hope they would continue to organize the free yoga classes ( although it is only 30 min, it is good for the trip) relaxing , thx

Friendly staff, the hotel is close to the station and very convenient for travel. The room is not big, but it is worth the price. If you have a lot of luggage, you may need to pay attention to the lack of space.

My family enjoyed one night stay with Onsen within room. Breakfast is excellent with adequate amount of choice while not too heavy. Also, 10-15minutes walk to YangMingShan park and dinner at 10-15 minutes drive to restaurants with Taipei city view are must-do.
Location is very good. The front desk staffs and housekeeping staffs are friendly. It was a pleasant stay.

Very nice hotel. We enjoyed  the pool and the sauna (women and men seperated). The breakfast buffet was very good. We even tried some food we never ate before. Staff was very helpful, friendly and they all spoke English.

We had a windowless room. Good size room and bathroom; both were updated so it was comfortable. Staff and service were excellent, and the facilities were well maintained. Iconic views from all areas of the property. Highly recommended.

The room is very big and old, the shower equipment is very old, the carpet is very messy, the sofa is full of fleas and bites, it is not recommended to stay here, the house price is fickle and deceptive, they say there is only one room left, but the room is gone as soon as I place the order. There is one room, and it’s cheap, so cool😡

This is our first time in Taipei and this hotel was bonus for this trip. Centrally located to all tourist spots and major night markets.  Taxi and Uber to everywhere is very affordable. We had a group of  5 and it worked out perfectly.  Thank you for the so helpful and friendly staffs. We will definitely recommend this hotel .

I chose Santos hotel because all its rooms have windows. I got a regular sized hotel room with 2 twin beds, Location not in a busy part of town which is ok. . Hotel is not new but the room was clean, sheets and towels were pristine white. Generous with bottled water, coffee, tea in sachets. Staff were very helpful. Carpet can do with shampooing. Bedskirt needs to be replaced. A 5-10 min walk to the train station, very convenient. From the airport I took the bus, got off across the hotel and just walked short distance. Took bus going back to airport. Was able to go to bus stn via the train. Pics show view from my window and bus trip sched.They serve buffet meals. I would recommend this hotel for these reasons.

It was a very clean and excellent hotel.
The room was clean, including the washroom, and the toilet was also clean.

There was also a gym with a wide variety of machines, which was great.

However, it is a little far from the station, so if you have a carry-on bag I recommend taking a taxi.
The room has a peculiar smell, the facilities are old, and the water volume at the bathroom sink is difficult to control. Water sprays everywhere. It is recommended to check room 1502.

Great location but BF same everyday.
This is one of the best hotel to stay in Taipei

My stay at Taipei Tiancheng Hotel was very comfortable. The rooms are tidy, the facilities are complete, and the staff are friendly and helpful. The location is convenient, close to major transportation, convenient for travel, highly recommended!

Great property in a good location with a mall and MRT nearby.  The staff’s service was top notch making our stay truly enjoyable.  The value for money was unbeatable, providing a fantastic experience.  Highly recommended!
Customer Service is extremely well and helpful. Room is very clean, love the hotel and will choose and recommend to stay in this hotel again. Thank you very much

Stayed here for 8 nights and it was perfect! Rooms are clean and spacious, staff are all so kind! Breakfast spread was more delicious had a lot of choices. Pool and gym were good as well.  If we were to visit Taipei, we would love to stay here again! Definitely recommend!

good clean large room and great location across the large carrefour.
not exactly walking distance from ximending but also just a one bus stop ride or 3 minute taxi.
not the warmest of staff though; very clinical and to the point.
Great rims Excellent BF Great location

I had a wonderful stay at Palais De Chine Hotel! The hotel is elegant, well-maintained, and the staff are incredibly professional and attentive. Best of all, it's in a fantastic location—right next to Taipei Main Station, which made getting around the city super convenient.

Check-in was smooth, and the front desk staff were welcoming and efficient. I also appreciated the prompt response from the housekeeping and maintenance teams when I reported a choked basin and slippery bathroom floor—they resolved everything quickly and even provided a non-slip mat for safety.

A special shout-out to Ricoh and Ting from the concierge team. On a rainy day, Ricoh saw my family and me waiting outside and kindly brought us under shelter while he got a taxi for us. Ting was always attentive and ready to help with transportation. She also made sure my elderly mother was safely in the car before closing the door. Their thoughtful service really stood out.

Highly recommend this hotel for anyone visiting Taipei. I’ll definitely be back!

the hotel is near to MRT station exit 1. nearby can find 7-11, family mart and watson. restaurant can be found about 2 street behind. it's good place to get dinner, but don't be too late cos normally restaurant close around 9pm. will recommend to my friends and family.

Room and bathroom were clean and well maintained, but a bit too small and ctamp for 2 travellers sharing the room.  Not much space for luggage.  Hotel overall dining options were good and convient to casual eating places and convenience store.  Would recommend for single traveller more, good rate and good room.
Location is pretty convenient, around 2min walk to MTR. 10mins walk to Ximengding. Room is spacious for 2 adults and 2 young kids. Would recommend.

It was conveniently located in the city center, near the MRT station. I checked in after a late flight, but there were no issues at all, and all the staff were kind. They also happily assisted with restaurant reservations and luggage storage after check-out. The facilities were not particularly old, and there was a washlet as well. I highly recommend it if you don't mind not being right in front of Taipei Station.

Location is superb, but the entire hotel has this mouldy smell/odour and it is unpleasant. Moreover, the room is relatively small at this price range, would recommend other hotels within the vicinity.

Very close to subway
So clean room and housekeeping 
Very friendly staff
I highly recommend ??
Hotel is old but clean, Great location, just next to the MRT. Breakfast is average but you can choose buffet at 13th floor or set American breakfast at ground floor. good choice of food around hotel.
excellent location, good breakfast! fast in check in and check out.
Good value for money and location.

It’s a good place to stay and relax. The room is very spacious and comfortable. Walkable distance to Xiaonanmen mrt station. there is shuttle bus every 2 hours to XiMending or Longshan temple (both location have mrt). There is a shops and even carrefour near the hotel with a 5mins distance walk. The staff is very friendly and would also recommend places to visit.  Do take note that there is a deposit of SGD$220 during check-in. Will definitely come back again!
great location, great breakfast !
Very beautiful Hotel. I will recommend to everyone to stay there.  Great restaurants, great service beautiful interior.

I will give most recommended hotel in taipei, all staffs are fluent in english and helpful, nice room, clean and quiet with AI helping you to control an electric stuff in room, waking you up with alarm, playing music. The hotel are located in non-crowded area and safe neighborhoods. waking just like 5-10 minutes from mrt green line xionanmen station.
Located at the heart of Xinyi  shopping district, very close to city hall station. Decent hotel with nice room, excellent location for shopping.
Great location next to subway station. Spacious room ideal for family.

The hotel is old but is well managed with modern era renovations.
It is located at a strategic point on the subway.
Very clean place, and most importantly (No smookinge smell) in the rooms!
Breakfast "is a little weak" but meets basic needs.
Parking is chaotic, you have to wait for spaces.
But in general, I recommend it to everyone!
It's good. I stayed for four days. This is the best value for money with the largest room near Ximending.
Its an old hotel. But for the price i paid i  cannot complain. They have clean good spacious rooms. Its peaceful and quiet. And free breakfast. I would gladly recommend it. Its value for money.
Overall a great stay. Have great breakfast shop nearby and walking distance to both train and bus station.  Would recommend.
nice hotel… highly recommended and worth the price…. 👌👌👌👌👌
great location and service. we enjoyed the small touches like a sparkling water dispenser on every floor and the variety of equipment in the gym
Excellent location, service is great.
Very good service, nice dinner and breakfast, nice room, nice hot spring experience, we have a wonderful day! Highly recommended

The hotel is very comfortable and the environment is very clean. The location of the hotel is very convenient. The hotel staff are very polite and made me feel a different journey. I will definitely recommend this hotel again next time.
Great stay, clean big hotel, great location near Ximending but not noisy, spacious nice riverview hotel. Great breakfast, will stay there again next time there

Great location with departmental stores near the hotel. The staffs were able to arrange a baby cot for my 10 months old and they try their best to accommodate to our requests of putting two guest rooms side by side. However we noticed that not all rooms came with a bath tub.

Best experience money can buy. From alighting to entering the room, everything is smooth and pleasant. 

Ordering room service food isn’t exactly the best however. It’s rather pricey and for that price, I’d Recommend to ordering FoodPanda etc.

I think the hotel is old
But the location and staff are very friendly.
It's great if you think about the location
If you think about facilities, we recommend other places
Very helpful. Excellent service. Great central location. Would recommend it to others.
I recommend staying at this hotel. The room was clean, spacious and the staff are all friendly.
It's a bit far from Ximen Station, but it's a good value hotel.
Great location, delicious breakfast, great service, highly recommended
Staff were all very friendly. Great location. Our room was clean and spacious.
I stayed with my mom, the location was good, the friendliness was good, great value for money.

The check-in time is very slow, there is no service, the hygiene is poor, no one cleans the room every day, and no one comes unless you call to clean it. When we checked in, we agreed to a late check-out, but they said we hadn't said that and even told us to call the police. It's a really rubbish hotel. Don't come, don't stay at this hotel. We booked two rooms and 4 little babies, but they urged us to check out immediately in the morning, and the door card was also blocked. They said they would call the police. It's a rubbish hotel.

Transportation and eating are convenient, directly connected to the subway exit, opposite the Starlight March Shopping Center, surrounded by many snacks, milk tea and convenience stores. The room is quite spacious by Taipei standards, the hygiene is good, and the towels and bathrobes are very clean. The facilities have a sense of age, the quality of the shampoo provided is not good, and the hair is frizzy after washing. Not even moisturizer/hand cream provided. There are many guests and the lobby downstairs is busy. You need to wait for check-in and you cannot delay check-out.

Large room, clean and comfortable.  Breakfast is excellent.
Check in process very slow need improvement.

We stayed on the 10th floor and had a beautiful city view, just as I had requested through Agoda. The hotel staff were incredibly accommodating and prepared everything as requested, which made our stay even more special.

Room:
The room was spacious enough for the four of us, including an infant. It felt cozy, was well-lit, and offered a lovely view. The beds were extremely comfortable, and the hallways were clean and nicely designed.

Cleanliness:
Even though we left our room untidy after heading out each day, the housekeeping staff did an impressive job of tidying everything up.

Internet:
The Wi-Fi was fast, which allowed me to work seamlessly at night.

Breakfast:
The breakfast was delicious, though there was a long queue depending on the time we went. We loved the wide variety of food options available.

Staff:
The staff were attentive and efficient. Whenever I requested items, they delivered them to our room in less than 10 minutes (though I assume this may vary depending on the time of day). It was my birthday during our stay, and they left a thoughtful letter and they even sent a small but delicious cake to celebrate the occasion.

Perks:
One fun perk was that they provided us with two plastic bags, which we could fill with complimentary candies and chocolates everyday.

Location:
The hotel is conveniently located just a 15-minute walk from Ximending Night Market. We also used their shuttle bus service to visit Longshan Temple.

Overall:
Our trip to Taipei was fantastic, and this hotel contributed to the experience. I would definitely recommend it to others and would love to stay here again.

I was disappointed in Taipei Garden. The location is excellent. However, check-in was slow and unorganized. We arrived at 3pm, the check in time, to long lines and our rooms not being ready. Then, the staff wrote down the wrong room number and my 80-year old parents had to go up and down and wait over 20-min before it could be resolved and they were let into their room. 

The hotel lobby does not have a true “lobby” sitting area where guests could meet us. Decor also was a bit kitschy. Overall, it was a disappointment compared to other 5-star hotels we stayed in in Taiwan and Taipei.
Waiting time for check in was too long, nearly take abt 1 hr!!

I stayed for 4 nights and 5 days from March 10 to 13.
On the first day, I arrived at 1 PM and waited until 2 PM to check in and was assigned to the 1-bed room that I had requested in advance.
For reference, the female staff during the day felt a bit stiff.
I have been working in the service industry for over 15 years, but I felt like I needed some training on customer service.
On the other hand, the female staff who spoke Korean seemed to be running around trying to solve problems, but I was disappointed that she seemed to lack professionalism.
When I asked for a high floor at the front desk, they assigned me to the 11th floor, which was not bad.
The rooms were cleaned cleanly during the 4 nights and 5 days, and the bathroom was also cleaned well, so I was able to relieve my fatigue in the bathtub after every tour.
The only regret was that there were no cotton pads among the amenities.
Other than that, I think I was satisfied with everything.
Later, I heard that this hotel was visited by many Japanese people, so there were many people who were fluent in Japanese. I would rate this as one of the top five hotels I've ever stayed at in Asia.

台北車站 has become an old district this decade. Caesar Hotel displayed this image completely: old. Carpet has blood stain. Check-in was delayed. Attitude of counter servicers are differentiably worser than Taichung's. The family mart underneath will closed. Better options are available with this price. It is also understandable the reason of the star-rating lowering from 5 to 4.

When you check in, you still have to wait for the room to be cleaned. There is a drink at the bar to take a rest, but it's a bit exaggerated to have to wait since you didn't check in very early. The room is clean, the bed and pillows are hard, and the swimming pool is beautiful

Definitely not a 5 star hotel... more like 3 stars. The lobby is very dated with a 3-person sofa. The rooms are alright. Location is OK if you are willing to take busses, otherwise you may have to walk a bit to get to MRT station. The reception desk lacks customer service and often times abit unfriendly.

Unfriendly person at the checking. Although I have a gold Hilton membership, no particular welcome attention and more over, no point added to my membership as I booked through Trip rather than on Hilton site.
Very modern designed room (too dark to my taste with little lights) and great bathroom.
Good breakfast.

The female receptionist at the hotel was extremely rude. She kept interrupting the guest before they even finished speaking and kept talking about what she wanted to say. Besides being rude, she was also inattentive and unprofessional. She gave me the wrong room card and let me into someone else's room.
everything was great except for the morning breakfast crew at the restaurant, was kinda rude and sulky.
The toilet was smelly. The baggage handler was rude and made me sigh loudly.
The front desk staff seemed a bit unfriendly during our check-in process.

I love our stay here at Taipei garden hotel. We brought my 82 yo mom and she was comfortable with the stay. Except for a rude front desk staff I encountered on an early morning time, our stay was perfect.
Good location but staff were very rude

Everything couldn't be better. But one thing was disappointing. I asked for 4 additional towels, but the staff called back and asked me why. When I told them there was no specific reason, rhey gave me 2 more towels. I think it's very rude to ask the customer why they need extra towels. I've never been asked that question until now.

This is my second time staying at the hotel within the same year. Stayed with my family and friends this time round. 

Plus points: Rooms are spacious, Excellent view, Prompt service. Good spread of breakfast. Top floor gym offering almost panoramic view of surroundings.

Area that can be improved:
The housekeeping of the hotel rooms can be further improved. Despite the rooms that we were staying in have been recently renovated (why are there 2 letters indicating renovating that almost span 1 year), the general cleanliness of the room is much to be desired and definitely can be improved. One of the rooms that we were staying have to be cleaned again before we stayed in (I'll spare the details here).  Was offered "compensation" in the form of drinks voucher. However, instructions for the drinks voucher at taipei garden hotel thai restaurant are not clear. It is indicated redemption is between 1400 to 1700 daily which we are usually not at the hotel within that timing. Service by the staff at the thai restaurant is also below par and borderline on being unfriendly.

Despite the above, special praise to the 打扫阿姨 thats on duty for 28th of August morning; bumped in to her during leaving the room. Left feedback of the areas of the room that's found to be unsatisfactory clean previously. She took the feedback given seriously and clean the room thoroughly when we were away. Excellent and detailed cleaning for service recovery,

The hardware is very good. Maybe it was because we were there during the Chinese New Year and there was no priority for guests to book the hotel's restaurant. I tried contacting the front desk: there was a lady named Tina who was unfriendly and unhelpful. She liked to taunt you very much. You know what she said. . . She alone can increase the hotel's rating. On the contrary, the concierge was very helpful and polite, and always responded to us in a timely manner. Overall evaluation: The hotel hardware is good and clean. The room service is very good. I give it 5 stars. But please don’t go to Taipei during the Spring Festival. We couldn’t book the hotel restaurant several weeks in advance. We were very unhappy and gave it 2 stars (Ctrip did not remind us that the hotel will not give priority to our stay). Guests book restaurants), the front desk has 2 stars, and the concierge has 5 stars!

Great place, clean, and everything.
Check-in counter staff is absolutely deplorable I have never encountered such ill-mannered staff. 
Full annoyed face and sharp words, didn't make an effort to confirm our requests, and failed to make simple confirmations. 
More so one of the staff completely ignored us and went past us directly beckoning her clients into the elevator. Afterwards the audacity of closing the elevator ON US who are waiting to enter the elevator. She swiped the card on the respective floors then AGAIN ignored us and left, fending us for ourselves.

Its a real shame the hotel would hire such unprofessional rookies as their front because all the other staffs were extremely warm and welcome.

The hotel staff are very polite and helpful, and I didn't find them to be as rude as other reviews have said.
The location is excellent and it is very convenient to go anywhere. It is only a one-minute walk from Exit 2 of Shandao Temple MRT Station. This is the most attractive reason for me to choose Sheraton
The hotel is large and has many guests, but due to its history, the room facilities are relatively old, and there is a musty smell when the door is opened. I think the hotel is aware of this problem, so we have an air purifier in the room, but it doesn't help much. This is the biggest reason why I think this hotel deserves criticism. I hope the hotel will improve it.
Finally, this accommodation experience is satisfactory to me.

I recently stayed at the Miramar Hotel in Taipei and was quite disappointed with my experience. Despite being advertised as a 5-star hotel, it fell short in several areas.

We stayed at Hotel Cosmos Taipei with a toddler for 4 nights and had a comfortable and enjoyable stay.

Location:
Perfectly located just a few steps from Exit M3 of Taipei Main Station, making travel within the city very convenient. Restaurants, cafés, and stores are nearby too.

Room:
Spacious, clean, and well-equipped. Despite being opposite the lift, the room was very quiet. It had a Toto toilet, ample storage, and an AI assistant with Bluetooth speaker (though not very responsive). We had a partial view of Taipei Main Station, but the windows were quite dirty.

Breakfast:
Breakfast was decent but limited for vegetarians — mostly fruits, salads, cereals, and a few stir-fried dishes. Labels could be clearer regarding vegetarian options as most dishes contained meat including noodles and pasta. One staff member was quite rude about finishing breakfast by 10 AM, which felt unnecessary, but all others were polite and helpful.

Service & Extras:
Front desk staff were welcoming and friendly. We received complimentary drink coupons for 17 Café and a bath bomb for our toddler — a thoughtful gesture.

Overall:
A great stay overall! Clean, comfortable, and conveniently located. With a few small improvements — like more vegeterian options, better vegetarian labelings and cleaner windows — this hotel could be an excellent choice for anyone visiting Taipei.

The floor was very low, and when we showered, water would leak out, soaking the entire bathroom. The water hadn't dried up by the next day. The room was sloppy, and the bottled water wasn't refilled.

We went for breakfast at 9:30 AM, but they wouldn't refill the food. The dishes and cups were gone, and they weren't actively refilling them. I saw everyone else using soup bowls for coffee, essentially using whatever was left. The next day, the candy bag disappeared. When I asked the front desk for another, they had to explain where the previous one went and reminded me not to lose it and to recycle it. I had to repeatedly remind my child not to lose the plastic bag.

This is definitely not hotel quality; at best, it's just hotel service. I was very disappointed. I definitely won't be back again and do not recommend staying at the Taipei Garden Hotel.

The lifts from the ground floor to the lobby are extremely slow, which I don't quite understand since it is only six floors up; the lifts from the lobby to the rooms are fine though. 

You can request an extra bed for only some types of rooms (the more expensive ones) which I understand because of the limited size of the rooms. However, the extra beds are really expensive, way above the median, almost half of what I paid for the room.

The fitness room, located on the 8th floor, normally closes at 10pm, but you can request to use the gym 24/7, however you will need to sign a waiver, which I thought was inconvenient for a five star hotel.

The best part was when I tried to use the shower, the drain didn't work properly and the water went everywhere. Thankfully the maintenance and housekeeping staff were quick in responding to this emergency at midnight.

Not recommended, the waiter in the lobby has a bad attitude and is shady. We arrived in the morning and already knew that the room would not be available until 3:00. We originally wanted to ask how to store our luggage, but no matter what we asked, the lobby attendant only said: "You can only check in at 3:00 pm" and did not care about us at all. What are you asking? He just wants to send us away. The room is large, but the equipment is old and the toilet in the room is clogged. You have to ask the housekeeper to connect the room to the toilet before you can use it. We booked online and found that the one-night price was $1,300. There should be better options nearby for this price, and we will not stay here again next time.

The location is close to Ximending. Parking is available. The staff is friendly. However, during my stay, there was a problem with the toilet. The toilet was clogged until midnight because the water kept overflowing from the toilet when flushing. I finally called the receptionist. The staff came to fix it and everything was fine.
Very friendly and professional staffs. Room is clean and cozy. The facilities are a bit old.  You can hear people talking in the hallway. The shower is leaking from the bottom.

The room is spacious, the view is great, the bathroom is large, but the bathtub water is not hot enough, the electronic scale is broken, the sauna area is too small and crowded, the breakfast is rich and large, but the eggs are average quality, and the omelette is too hard.
Very central and many bus options, after showering water is leaking out of the shower

Very big room, great location but for the money paid, facilities should have been better/newer. 
1. Onsen bathtub in the room has some obvious stains
2. Water leaked from bathroom to sofa area after shower (not a lot of water luckily) 
3. Power went off for like 1-2 sec twice. Though very briefly, needa turned on TV and lights again one by one, which was kinda troublesome (and not what I expected from a hotel this expensive)

Location and staff are good.
The kettle is not working when we use it, shower head was broken while when use during bathing.Location and staffs are good but there are a few things that I am really pissed off and unsatisfied about. The kettle is not working when we first got the room, the shower head suddenly fell out when having shower, the sound cancellation between rooms are so bad, i could literally listen to what people were saying next door, the staff even threw my towel away when they doing the cleaning, we also have breakfast there which is till 10am and they already start putting the food back to the kitchen at 9:30am, how ridiculous. This is literally unacceptable, wouldn’t come back again

The hotel is clean, the environment is comfortable, the staff is polite, the service is good, the toilet light bulb is broken, it was quickly fixed, the buffet breakfast has many styles and the food is delicious. I traveled with my parents this time, and they were also very satisfied 😊

Booked this hotel last minute, checked in very late. The road up the mountain is a bit winding but not sparsely populated. The environment is OK. The air is filled with a strong smell of sulfur. Surprisingly, there is an indoor personal hot spring pool. The breakfast is also good. The swimming pool is also great. It takes about 20 minutes to call a taxi. It costs 500NT to go directly to Songshan Airport. This price, facilities and services are great value. There are a few problems that I hope the hotel can pay attention to and deal with in time. The first is that there is no Wi-Fi signal on the first floor. The second is that the air-conditioning controller in the room seems to be out of order. If it is set to 24 degrees, whether the air-conditioning is turned on or only the air is sent, it is actually stable at 19 degrees, which is quite cold. It is very stuffy when the air-conditioning is turned off. I have reported these two problems to the front desk staff. Unfortunately, there has been no solution in two days.
The room is very simple, the toilet flushing power is not enough, and the toilet is often clogged

I opened the quilt and found hair residue. It is understandable that the humidity is high in the mountains, but the bathtub plug in the toilet is broken and has not been repaired. The mold on the side of the bathtub is really unacceptable. The refrigerator in the room does not work at all...
Although there is a bathtub for bathing 🛁, the switch of the shower head 🚿 cannot be pulled up and water cannot be discharged. I can only take a bath with leaking bathtub water.
The washbasin faucet is broken, and the toilet drain and switch are broken.

Great location, right next to metro. Room clean and tidy.
Some suggesting, shower water facing bathroom door, water leaked out to bedroom and wet floor. A suitable thickness mat to absorb water that can go beneath the door should be placed to avoid wet floor.

It was a hotel with a lot of historical meaning. Our room was in the annex behind the main building, so it was renovated and cleaned up, but the air conditioner didn't work and we couldn't adjust the temperature to our liking. It was fixed by the hotel, so it was so hot we couldn't get a rest. Also, the ventilation was poor, so on hot days the humidity was so high that the shower didn't let out all the moisture, making it uncomfortable. As it is a very old hotel, the facilities are probably old as well, which was the only disappointing thing. But it was a memorable hotel, and if you were to stay there again, I would definitely recommend the main building.

Stayed in this so-called 5-star hotel for 3 nights. The power went out continuously from 2am on the second night. The fire indicator light on the ceiling was on and off, and it was on for a long time from 4am, which affected my sleep all night. There was no hot water or WiFi on the third morning. When I went out at 11am, there was no elevator for guests, so I had to use the staff elevator. When I came back at 6pm, I was still using the staff elevator.
Until you check out, there is no formal apology or explanation, as if these things never happened.




I highly recommend not staying at this hotel and will never consider staying at this group of hotels

The hotel is terrible. There was no hot water for showering. The temperature felt only 8 degrees tonight. I called the front desk, but found that the phone was broken and could not be used. I could only use roaming data to make the call. Finally, at around midnight, the technician came up to fix it. He placed all the tools on the bed, but still couldn't fix it. He could only use the lobby phone outside the room, and there was still no hot water.
Very dated hotel. Had to change room due to smoke smell. Not very clean and no hot water in shower. Location is convenient to MRT. Need an update to secure better review.

Bad  and smelly rooms .with no hot water ..
Old bathroom which looked abandoned.
There are two buildings 1 old the other new ..
Stay in the new building if you can ..after booking my room and arriving at. 11pm 
The people at the reception wouldn’t allow me to change the room to the new building..
Pictures are deceiving on Agoda ..
Not the real pictures that you get .
Cost is decent but the shower room will have water leakage into toilet room, which is not good

The hotel is an old hotel renovated, and the smell of sewerage in the room is very pungent.
The sheets, bath towels, and towels are very worn. The worst thing is that the room does not provide any disposable items or bottled water. In the name of environmental protection, if you want to drink water, you have to walk a long way to the elevator to get water with a kettle, which is outrageous. .
The shower hook in the bathroom cannot be hung. It fell down when taking a shower and hit my feet. The toilet seat is broken and cannot be used. The management is lazy. The hotel looks good. The rooms are like Home Inns. It is rare to encounter rooms with 4 stars. An old hotel, not worth recommending. I feel cheated after booking.

Like I stated at the topic, the room is a bit old, and in the last day of my trip the shower was not working ( no hot water coming out from the tap), so we had to switch our room, not a very good experience i will say
